entry_conditions: Drawer closed, partly open or just opened; finite reachable TCP/joints; coherent TCP-to-drawer and TCP-to-red relations; observable gripper. Prefer modest path deviation rather than arbitrary failure recovery.
exit_conditions: Nominal switch cue is drawer_position safely above 0.26 m with near-zero velocity, drawer front released, and red aligned, closed upon and observably co-moving upward with the TCP.
overlap_role: Every action 0:470 is supervised. Actions 230:470 duplicate red_transfer receiving supervision on both sides of front release and red pickup, totaling 240 actions per trajectory and 2,880 actions.
successor_readiness: red_transfer may receive after opening and red exposure at 230; the clean nominal handoff is red/TCP co-motion with closed fingers near 470.
failure_signatures: Repeated local motion without drawer progress; unexpected drawer motion; growing TCP-to-front or TCP-to-red error; closure without red co-motion; red drop; accumulated pose drift; IK nonconvergence or limit contact.
continuation_guidance: Apply local increments only while observed progress is consistent with a represented approach/pull/release/pickup phase. Switch to red_transfer after opening or initial lift. Replan rather than continuing if relations diverge.
limitations: The overlap demonstrates nominal continuation, not recovery. Local increments are not globally object-displacement invariant and do not provide contact truth, collision checking or guarantees under large configuration changes.
